name: Shared-account capital comparison
verdict: Replaying the combined portfolio in one account at $5k-$20k: minimum commissions, whole shares and shared buying power break the return-stream estimate. No allocation met the objective.
description: Account replays at $5k, $10k, $15k and $20k, including stress, older periods, account verification and every saved daily account/order/flow table. Dates below describe the main comparison; older replays have their own periods.
